faq.title: Got questions?
faq.subtitle: Here you'll find answers to the most common questions about our restaurant.
faq.q1: Do I need to book a table?
faq.a1: We recommend booking, especially on weekends. You can do it from this website or call us at +34 682 239 035.
faq.a2: We will be launching our online ordering and delivery service very soon. Stay tuned!
faq.q3: Do you have options for allergies or intolerances?
faq.a3: Yes, all our dishes have allergens listed. You can also filter the menu by allergens right here on the website.
faq.a4: Yes, we accept credit/debit card and cash at both locations.
faq.q5: What are the restaurant opening hours?
faq.a5: Tarragona: Tue–Sun 19:00–23:30. Arrabassada: Wed–Tue 10:00–23:30. Check the locations section for more details.
faq.q6: Can I book for large groups?
faq.a6: For groups of more than 10, please call us directly at +34 682 239 035 to arrange your booking.
faq.a7: Absolutely! All our dough is made fresh daily with quality ingredients following the traditional Italian recipe.
faq.a8: We have two locations: one in Tarragona city centre and another in the Arrabassada area. Check the locations section for exact addresses.
